message: No detected input validation: The code loads datasets directly from sklearn and passes them to preprocessing without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded exclusively from sklearn's built-in datasets (load_wine, load_diabetes), with no remote sources, so no checksum or authentication checks are present or needed—but none are implemented.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label values against an expected set, no label distribution comparison, and no use of any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab anywhere in the data preparation code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation steps only perform fuzzification and train/test splitting; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious inputs applied to the training data.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch using sklearn datasets and custom fuzzy tree classes; no pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded, and no hash/signature verification is performed anywhere in the visible code.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor detection, trigger analysis, activation inspection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used in any part of the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/test split is used, there is no signing or hashing of evaluation data, no multiple independent metrics beyond accuracy, and no explicit isolation mechanism preventing leakage between training and test sets.
No detected input sanitization: The code loads data directly from sklearn datasets and passes it to the model without any shape, range, type, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Predictions from fclf.predict() and clf.predict() are passed directly to accuracy_score with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or output sanity validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular decision tree classifier/regressor, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
